raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / TRILOCALE CON TERRAZZO | VISTA MARE A JESOLO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Trilocale con Terrazzo | Vista Mare a Jesolo PIAZZA MILANO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €245,000 Photos (12) Floor plans (0) 1 / 12 FLOOR AREA 75 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS F Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo! In the heart of Via Altinate, just a few meters from the beach and surrounded by all essential services, we offer for sale a bright apartment on the second floor with an ideal south-facing exposure. The combination of proximity to the sea, a well-served area, and the convenience of a communal uncovered parking space on rotation makes this solution a golden opportunity both for those seeking a summer residence to enjoy year-round and for investors aiming at high returns in the Jesolo tourist market. The internal layout is rational and well-distributed: Upon entering, you are welcomed by the living area which opens directly onto a habitable terrace, perfect for outdoor dining while enjoying sea views. The sleeping area hosts one double bedroom and another twin bedroom. The absence of an elevator significantly reduces management costs and condominium fees, maximizing net yield for potential investment. "Turnkey Solution" with Renovation Included: The asking price includes both the purchase of the property as well as its complete renovation. The visual materials and renders presented showcase tailored interior redesign proposals developed specifically for this apartment: A unique opportunity to acquire a completely renewed property that is modernized and enhanced in every detail without the stress of managing construction work. A comprehensive proposal that is solid and ready to transform into your new seaside home or guaranteed income source.
